lines.text: OpenCode in SpecWithCode: one task, planned, built and reviewed.
lines.spoken: Open Code in Spec With Code: one task, planned, built, and reviewed.

lines.text: In your repo, run specweave init. It adds AGENTS.md and seven SpecWeave skills, such as sw-increment and sw-do.
lines.spoken: In your repo, run spec weave init. It adds agents dot M D, and seven spec weave skills, such as S W increment, and S W do.

lines.text: Open SpecWithCode and set this Mac up as your main machine. OpenCode isn't in the first-run list, so continue past it.
lines.spoken: Open Spec With Code, and set this Mac up as your main machine. Open Code isn't in the first-run list, so continue past it.

lines.text: OpenCode signs in with its own CLI. In Settings, Providers, SpecWithCode has already turned OpenCode on, because its CLI is signed in.
lines.spoken: Open Code signs in with its own C L I. In Settings, Providers, Spec With Code has already turned Open Code on, because its C L I is signed in.

lines.text: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. The project opens on its coordinator.
lines.spoken: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. The project opens on its coordinator.

lines.text: Choose a model. OpenCode lists every model your account can use. Search for one, such as Claude Sonnet 5.5.
lines.spoken: Choose a model. Open Code lists every model your account can use. Search for one, such as Claude Sonnet five point five.

lines.text: Set Full access for this demo, describe the change, and send it. The coordinator hands the work to a new thread.
lines.spoken: Set Full access for this demo, describe the change, and send it. The coordinator hands the work to a new thread.

lines.text: The thread plans increment 1: acceptance criteria and one task with its test. Then it changes the code and runs that test. A task is done only when its test passes.
lines.spoken: The thread plans increment one: acceptance criteria, and one task with its test. Then it changes the code, and runs that test. A task is done only when its test passes.

lines.text: Open the thread to review it: the summary, the verification and review reports, and every changed file in Open diff.
lines.spoken: Open the thread to review it: the summary, the verification and review reports, and every changed file in Open diff.

lines.text: Increment 1 is verified and closed. Next, run the same task with another agent.
lines.spoken: Increment one is verified and closed. Next, run the same task with another agent.
